paragraph: Granville’s timing system delivers a strong bullish primary verdict this morning with a composite score of 81/100, unencumbered by any active breadth divergence warnings. Internal market leadership is firing on all cylinders, driven by surging risk appetite in high-beta equities (SPHB/SPLV +1.40%), semiconductor strength (SOXX/SPY +1.36%), and economic transport confirmation (IYT/SPY +0.65%), all while defensive staples heavily underperform discretionary (XLP/XLY -1.96%). The macro backdrop fully confirms this risk-on tone, featuring a complacent VIX at 14.94 within a steep contango term structure, tight high-yield credit spreads anchored at 2.71%, and small-cap outperformance (0.3894). Although 5Y5Y inflation expectations have ticked up to 2.29%, stable 10-year real yields at 2.41% and a softening dollar index ($28.08) ensure financial conditions remain supportive for equities. Given the clean alignment between internal breadth signals and benign macro conditions, the directional lean for today’s session is decisively bullish, favoring long positions in tech and high-beta cyclicals.
